jobs.description: Are you technically minded, precise, and motivated by building complex technical products? For ASML in Veldhoven, we are looking for multiple Assemblers who want to work on some of the most advanced technology in the world. As an Assembler, you will be responsible for accurately assembling, testing, and manufacturing complex modules and components. You will work according to technical drawings, work instructions, and established quality standards, with quality and precision always being your top priorities. You will work in a clean, high-tech production environment where precision, teamwork, and continuous improvement are key. It is an environment where your technical skills directly contribute to the quality and reliability of the products. Wie zoeken we? You are someone who works carefully and with a high level of concentration and enjoys assembling technical products. You have a strong eye for detail and understand that even the smallest deviation can be important when working with complex high-tech products. You are also a true team player. You communicate clearly, are open to feedback, and are willing to support your colleagues when needed. You take ownership of your work and do not hesitate to act when you identify a problem. You are eager to learn and motivated to further develop your technical skills within a high-tech environment. Because you may work with different products and activities, you are flexible and able to switch easily between tasks. What you bring MBO Level 3 or 4, preferably in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical field. Experience in a technical production or assembly environment. Experience assembling and testing electronic and/or mechatronic components. Experience working with hand tools such as torque wrenches, pliers, and precision tools. Ability to work with technical drawings and work instructions. Basic knowledge of electrical principles, such as resistance, induction, andhigh-voltage testing, is an advantage. Good command of the English language, both written and spoken. Conversational command of the Dutch language is an advantage. Experience working in a cleanroom or contamination-controlled environment is an advantage. Excellent fine motor skills and the ability to work with a high level of precision. Wat bieden wij je? As an Assembler at ASML, you will have the opportunity to work in one of the most innovative high-tech manufacturing environments in the world. You will receive an extensive onboarding program and the necessary training and guidance to become familiar with the work, products, and processes. In addition, we offer: A full-time position of 40 hours per week. A temporary assignment of 12 months. A day shift position. A gross monthly salary of up to €3,400, excluding bonus and holiday allowance. 27 days of paid annual leave. 13 ADV (working time reduction) days. A 13th-month salary, paid annually. An annual bonus based on the company's results. Extensive onboarding, training, and opportunities for further development. The opportunity to work in an international and highly innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines are used to produce the chips that form the foundation of virtually all modern technology. From smartphones and computers to cars and medical equipment, ASML's technology plays an important role in our everyday lives. As an Assembler, you are part of that impact. With your precision and craftsmanship, you ensure that complex modules are assembled and tested according to the highest quality standards. Every module you assemble contributes to the technology that enables the future of the semiconductor industry. Your work. Your craftsmanship. Your contribution to the technology of tomorrow.
